engine: Saisei's big-title reveal — a large serif title RISES from under a baseline mask, line by line (overflow:hidden wrapper + translateY(110% -> 0)), staggered, expo.out. Not a fade — the words slide up from behind the line, as if printed onto a rising sheet. Harvested from D_saisei (S5).

measured_teardown.move: each title line sits in an overflow:hidden wrapper; the inner line starts translateY(~110%) (below the mask) and animates to 0, staggered ~100-120ms per line, expo.out.
measured_teardown.cited: Saisei project hero v3 f066-073: SHIZUKA then GARDENS rise from under the baseline, per line, line-height ~0.9.

lineSelector.what: each line wrapper (overflow:hidden); its child is the moving text.

from.what: start offset of each line under the mask.

entry: MaskUpTitle.create(target, opts) -> { lines, play(o), set(p), reset(), destroy }. play() runs the staggered rise. set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub of all lines (drive from scroll if wanted). reset() back to hidden. Markup: a container with .mut-line wrappers (overflow:hidden), each holding the moving text as its first child.
law: transform(translateY) on the inner line + the wrapper's overflow:hidden only; GPU; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop; NO WebGL; reduced-motion -> instant shown. GSAP optional (drives a proxy that writes the SAME style.transform channel as set(), so play and set never fight). owns_pin false.
gate_mode: DOM text transform (no , triggered) — wheel-scroll gate does not apply. Verify the lines rise + settle smoothly in the combo.
proven: lab-full (combo) on OUR QUADRO: the QUADRO / HOUSE serif title rises from under the baseline mask, per line, stagger 0.12s, expo.out — verified translateY(0%) at rest. Full 4-brick transition probe: 0.3% long frames, 59.9fps.
